Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Siena hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the October 1, 2026 snapshot, at 16 of the 18 Siena hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 5, Hotels.com at 4, Agoda at 2, Booking.com at 2, the hotel's own site at 2 and Torre del Fuggisole - Boutique Hotel in centro a Siena at 1. These are the Siena rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at Siena hotels

At the 12 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 14% ($14 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 11% at Hotel Italia Siena to 16% at Il Chiostro del Carmine. At 6 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
